conversation.speaker: customer
conversation.text: 老板 昨天说组的那桌一点底杭麻后来组成了吗 现在还有位吗

conversation.speaker: shop
conversation.text: 我这边没查到昨天那桌一点底杭麻还在组，眼下也没有余位可报。要不我帮你重新凑一桌？

conversation.speaker: customer
conversation.text: 老板 那重新凑一桌吧 杭州麻将一点底 午后能到 还有位吗

conversation.speaker: shop
conversation.text: 午后一点底杭麻现在没有能搭的桌诶，我给你凑一桌的话，你说个开场时间吧，还是人齐了就开？

conversation.speaker: customer
conversation.text: 老板 那就人齐了开吧 午后都行 一点底杭麻

observed.rejected_create_reason: flexible game can start before the searched opening window starting at 2026-11-26T12:00:00+08:00; it has no enforceable earliest start

concrete_current_limit.lookup: search_current_games supports start_time_range for existing games.
concrete_current_limit.create: create_game accepts additional requirement keys, but the current lifecycle does not enforce earliest_start_at or a start_time_range for asap_when_full. Its derived latest_start_at is creation plus four hours, with no earliest opening guard represented by those fields.
concrete_current_limit.follow_up: schedule_follow_up can persist a limited re-evaluation of the current goal. It does not schedule or constrain a game opening, guarantee that recruitment will succeed, or authorize a downstream write.

verified_offline_handoff.path: Actual Runtime, SQLite and sandbox private delivery with deterministic model responses. The same scoped search ran, the unsupported flexible create was blocked, and a substantive clarification was delivered with zero game, invitation or room writes.
verified_offline_handoff.clarification: 午后暂时没找到能搭的现成桌。人齐开可能提前，你愿意定个午后的开场时间吗？
positive_controls: A new customer message explicitly selects 13:00. The existing fixed-time path verifies and creates one correct scheduled game, then delivers confirmation.
An independent immediate fill request with no future start constraints still creates an asap_when_full game, completes a real candidate lookup and delivers a receipt.

separate_feature.need: Support recruiting for a fill-based game whose actual opening is bounded by a durable earliest and latest local time.
separate_feature.product_decisions: Decide when recruitment may start, how to handle a roster filled before the earliest opening, and how to handle a roster incomplete at the latest opening.
separate_feature.future_acceptance: Later work should verify those invariants across synchronous create, join, actual play-start, scheduling and restart, without exposing an exact scheduled clock that the customer never agreed.
